issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְאֵשֶׁת נְעוּרִים כִּי תִמָּאֵס' means 'and a wife of youth when she is rejected' (i.e., a young wife who is rejected/despised), but the Chinese renders it as '被幼年妻子棄絕的' which reverses the subject/object: it says the man is rejected by his young wife, whereas the Hebrew says the young wife is rejected (by her husband). This changes who is doing what to whom.
